    - Going somewhere, *Player*? I know every old Tolmach path between here and the plain. I took my first caravan up alone at sixteen and whistled the whole way. Whistling's good for ledges.
    - You walk a ledge like a Tolmach now. Heel, then toe, and never look at what you'll miss. Corwell will want to hire you instead of me.
    - You've seen the Greywater now. Dry as a bone. I've carried extra skins all summer and told nobody, not even my mother. I keep meaning to.

    - Ennek, of the Tolmach. Canyon guide. Sennu's son, Mabbu's grandson, Kesh's cousin. Corwell hires me for nearly every lowland caravan, and I bring them up the old paths my family has walked since the founding.
    - Ketta? We grew up teasing each other. I guided her down the canyon road when she left at seventeen, and met her on the south path on her way home. There's something she won't talk about. I've never pressed her. I won't.
    - Ketta laughs more since the cave. She came to my fire last night and fell asleep mid-story, as if she hadn't slept properly in a year. I let her.
